name: Normal Operation
description: Flow and pressure remain near expected baseline with minor natural variation.
expected_effect: No active incident created; sensor status remains NORMAL.

name: Gradual Pipeline Leak
description: Sustained +30% flow increase and -23% pressure drop across 3 consecutive readings.
expected_effect: Creates or updates a High-Risk Suspected Incident requiring field verification.

name: Sudden Pipe Burst
description: Major arterial surge (+55% flow) and severe pressure drop (-34% pressure) for 3 consecutive readings.
expected_effect: Creates or escalates a Critical Priority Suspected Incident with high projected water loss.

name: Temporary Demand Spike
description: Short-lived flow increase (+26%) for 1 reading without sustained pressure loss, returning to baseline.
expected_effect: Enters MONITOR state only; prevents false-alarm incident creation.

name: Sensor Offline / Stale Data
description: Telemetry feed stops or reports STALE/MISSING quality flag.
expected_effect: Marks sensor as STALE/OFFLINE with blue/grey indicator; never shown as normal.

name: Post-Repair Recovery
description: 5 consecutive intervals returning flow and pressure smoothly back to baseline after field repair.
expected_effect: Marks zone anomaly as RECOVERED and recommends operator verification of resolution.
